subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Desperate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Desperate"** means feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with. (निराशाजनक)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt **desperate** when she couldn't find her lost dog.
 
 
 
• **"Hopeful"** refers to feeling or inspiring optimism about a future event. (आशावादी)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the challenges, he remained **hopeful** about the future.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Desperate'** is **'Hopeful'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sloping** (ढलान): Inclining or slanting.

 
 
• **Example:** The sloping roof helped to prevent water accumulation.
 
 
 
• **Bleak** (उदास): Lacking in warmth, life, or kindliness; not hopeful or encouraging.
 
 
• **Example:** The future looked bleak with no job prospects in sight.
 
 
 
• **Erratic** (अनियमित): Not even or regular in pattern or movement; unpredictable.
 
 
• **Example:** His erratic behavior made it difficult to predict what he would do next.
